entries.name: Furries
entries.content: Anthros, also called Furs, are sentient, anthropomorphic animals that encompass a wide variety of species, ranging from real-world creatures to prehistoric beasts (Prehistoria) and mythical creatures (Mythica). They walk on plantigrade legs and feet while retain defining traits of their species on humanoid frames, including fur, scales, feathers, or other natural coverings. Instinct plays a role in their behavior, though it is tempered by their human-like intelligence and social structures. All anthros have tails that reflect their species, aiding in balance and expression. Their height varies by species, with smaller ones like rabbits or mice being scaled up while still remaining shorter than larger species. Anthros typically range from 3 to 8 feet tall, depending on the natural size of the creature they resemble.

entries.name: Prehistoria
entries.content: Prehistoria is a category that includes all Anthros with origins dating back to before the end of the ice age, such as dinosaurs and ice age creatures. While most Anthros can integrate into modern society regardless of their species, Prehistoria Anthros often struggle with it due to their more primal instincts and behaviors. These instincts can manifest in unusual ways, reflecting their ancient heritage. Their heats are far more intense, often driving them into a state of mindless need to procreate with their mate. Additionally, they tend to have alternative views on lifestyles and may find modern social norms challenging to adapt to. Prehistoria Anthros are exceptionally rare, with their global population typically numbering in the thousands.

entries.name: Mythica
entries.content: Mythica is an umbrella category that collects all anthro species with origins from myth, folklore, and the supernatural. This includes beings such as dragons, kobolds, hellhounds, and kitsune, among others. While many anthro species exhibit stereotypical traits associated with their kind, Mythica species embody these traits at their core, shaping their existence and way of life. Often regarded as mysterious and exotic, they make up an incredibly small population, with some species numbering fewer than a thousand members worldwide. Scientists and governments continue to debate whether these beings possess true mystical abilities, as unusual phenomena frequently occur in their presence. However, a lack of concrete research and documentation leaves the nature and cause of these occurrences shrouded in mystery.
